source.basis: Bhrigu Nandi Nadi (BNN), re-interpreted as causative elements
source.label: KAT (modern method — Rahul Kaushik; based on Bhrigu Nandi Nadi)

safety_rules: Optional, zero-cost conduct alignment only; never a guarantee of results.
No purchase, ritual, donation or external object is required by this module.
KAT is a modern interpretive method with no independent validation; present it as such.
Never drop the engine's non-certainty language when presenting KAT options.
This module encodes only the publicly taught domain-triangle framework; specific paid-course prescriptions are not encoded.
principle: Diagnose the life domain, then work with only that domain-triangle's planets (plus the obstructing planet) through nature-aligned conduct, instead of attempting to strengthen all nine planets.

dharma.label: Personality / Self (Dharma triangle)
dharma.focus_note: For personality, confidence and vitality questions, work with Mars, Sun and Jupiter — plus whichever of them is obstructed — rather than all nine planets.

artha.label: Work / Career / Resources (Artha triangle)
artha.focus_note: For work, career and earnings questions, work with Saturn, Mercury and Venus — plus the obstructing planet — not all nine planets.

kama.label: Desire / Business / Relationships (Kama triangle)
kama.focus_note: For business growth and partnership questions, work with Mercury, Venus and Saturn — plus the obstructing planet.

moksha.label: Liberation / Inner Growth (Moksha triangle)
moksha.focus_note: For inner-growth and release questions, work with Moon, Mars and Jupiter — plus the obstructing planet.

marriage.note: KAT frames desire and partnership under the Kama triangle; SweetAstro maps marriage there.

children.note: SweetAstro adaptation: progeny is treated under the Dharma/personality triangle; KAT does not enumerate this topic.

property.note: SweetAstro adaptation: assets are treated under the Artha/resources triangle.

education.note: SweetAstro adaptation: learning is treated under the Dharma triangle (Jupiter).

siblings.note: SweetAstro adaptation: the 3rd house belongs to the Kama triangle.

health.note: KAT does not define a health triangle (health spans 6/8/12); SweetAstro adapts with the personality triangle and keeps confidence limited. Professional care always comes first.

general.note: SweetAstro adaptation: general questions use the personality triangle.
